current_root_conclusion: The primary actionable software root is Qt-event-loop wake dependent consumer capacity in the GUI-process architecture. Consumer process isolation removes the sustained deficit; increasing the isolated inbox batch cap from20 to40 removes the remaining wake-sensitive transient on saved input. The physical execution-state cause remains unidentified, and formal/field verification is still pending.
